rooms.name: Entrance
rooms.description: You stand at the mouth of a dimly lit cave, its walls adorned with glistening formations. The air is cool and musty, hinting at unseen creatures lurking within.

weapon.name: Unassuming Hilt
weapon.description: It seems to be a hilt of a fairly large sword.

rooms.name: Grog's Lair
rooms.description: A chamber filled with the stench of ale and stale bread.Dim torchlight flickers off the damp stone walls, casting eerie shadows around you.

monster.name: Grog
monster.description: He's a small, mischievous hobgoblin from folklore, known for playing tricks on humans.He seems a little dim-witted.

armor.name: Iron Boots
armor.description: It belongs to a small creature.
